listingTitle: Check Go errors before deferring Close
title: Check Go errors before deferring Close
why: A failed resource acquisition can leave a nil value, so deferring Close before checking the returned error can panic.
suggestion: Handle the error first, then defer Close after the resource is known to be valid.
limitations: Only named values assigned with an error and later closed through direct Close or Body.Close calls are recognized.
Aliases, helper-based error checks, and custom validity contracts are not inferred.
